messages:
Alex P: Pager duty alert 2min ago — surge of 429s on api/v1/generate. Seeing p95 latency jump too. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/429503/overview
Oncall Bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. Severity: Sev2. Linked runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ops/429-503-Mitigation
Samira K: grabbing dashboards now. Which clusters affected? region-us-east-1?
Maria G: Yes us-east-1 primary. Small uptick in eu-west but negligible. Heatmap shows concentrated at front-door tier (ingress-proxy) and model pool returning 503s for some tenants.
Alex P: customer-facing errors: spike in 429 token rejections and transient 503 from model-serving. Top 3 tenants by error volume: tenant-alpha, tenant-gamma, tenant-omega. pinging account teams.
Ilya SRE: logs show quota-exceeded errors from ratelimiter service + backlog on kv-cache eviction. Stacktrace: `ratelimiter.go:142: deny request, token-bucket empty`
Samira K: starting live mitigation: plan — 1) temporarily raise global burst limit from 20 -> 50 tokens for 60s; 2) enable tenant-level soft caps for noisy tenants; 3) disable low-value predictive-ranking feature flag for 15m; 4) watch 429/503 heatmap.
Alex P: +1. Can you post the commands? I want to be able to revert quickly.
Samira K: commands:
``
# increase global burst
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/config/ratelimiter -d '{"global_burst":50}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
# set tenant soft cap
curl -X POST https://control.redwood/api/v1/tenants/tenant-alpha/caps -d '{"rps_soft":120}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
# flip feature flag
curl -X POST https://ff.redwood.com/toggle -d '{"feature":"predictive_ranking","state":"off","duration_minutes":15}'
``
Maria G: running step 1 now.
Oncall Bot: Deploy event: config/ratelimiter updated by Samira K (ops). Change id cfg-8892.
Samira K: step1 applied. Global burst now 50. Watchers: p95 dropped from 880ms -> 420ms in the ingress-proxy metric.
Alex P: good. Any drop in 429 count?
Maria G: 429 rate down ~45% from peak on the cluster. 503s unchanged for model pool. Root cause seems mix of an upstream spike + cache thrash.
Ilya SRE: initiating step 2: applying tenant soft caps for tenant-alpha and tenant-gamma to reduce their share. Command done. tenant-alpha rps_soft=120, tenant-gamma rps_soft=100.
Samira K: applied feature flag off for predictive-ranking. Expect reduced downstream model load ~30%.
Oncall Bot: Feature flag changed: predictive_ranking off by Maria G (ops). Audit id ff-2233.
PagerDuty: Paging note — on-call rotation: Samira K is active, handing to Alex P in 30m for follow-up. If regress, escalate to SRE lead.
Maria G: model pool 503s decreased after feature flag flip, 503 rate down ~60% in 5m. KV-cache evictions still high but stabilizing.
Alex P: start customer comms draft: "We're seeing transient rate limiting and model timeouts; we've applied temporary caps and disabled a non-critical feature — service is degrading gracefully. Follow-up with SLA impact within 2 hours." Any objections?
Samira K: looks good. Send to account owners for tenant-alpha and tenant-gamma asap.
Alex P: done — pinged account owners. Notifying support to hold on escalations.
Ilya SRE: telemetry check: dashboard panels:
- grafana/redwood/429-503/heatmap p95
- grafana/redwood/ratelimiter/borrowed_tokens
- grafana/redwood/modelpool/503-traces
Keep an eye on KV cache eviction rate and queue length.
Maria G: eviction rate trending down. p95 ingress stable ~350ms. Will keep monitoring next 30m, will handoff to Alex at :30.
Samira K: prepping rollback playbook: revert ff, revert tenant soft caps, revert global_burst to 20. re-run if metrics stable for 15m.
Alex P: noted. Thanks team. I'll take over at 2112345880 and confirm stable before closing.
Oncall Bot: Incident update: mitigation active. Next update in 15m or on status change.
